rationale: Setup at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC is the only binding limit; hold (+0.08 ns, no buffers), slew/cap (0 of 89) and DRC (0) have headroom. Signoff slack lands ~0.13 ns above the setup margin; period (0.45), margins (0.4) and RC model (cap213 over-delivers, stock/orfs did not) are maxed. Port paths are the volatile limiter: stricter slew/cap repair (40/40) added ~30 buffers and dropped a port path to +0.389. Both settings relax slew/cap repair to 10/10, spending unused electrical headroom on fewer buffers: Setting 1 on the best util-30 run; Setting 2 on the util-38 die, which had the best reg-to-reg slack (+0.547) but was port-limited (+0.526).
